title: Wide Regular Subalgebras of Symmetrizable Kac-Moody Algebras and an Extension of Schur's Lemma
summary: The behavior of representations under restriction is a central theme in Lie theory. We study wide regular subalgebras of symmetrizable Kac--Moody algebras, extending work of Douglas and Repka on semisimple Lie algebras. A subalgebra is \emph{wide} if every irreducible integrable highest weight module remains indecomposable upon restriction. Let $\mathfrak{g}$ be a symmetrizable Kac--Moody algebra with Cartan subalgebra $\mathfrak{h}$, root system $Φ$, simple roots $Π$, and root space decomposition $\mathfrak{g}=\mathfrak{h}\oplus\bigoplus_{α\inΦ}\mathfrak{g}_α$.
